command: set -o pipefail; pid=$(pgrep -f '^/usr/bin/cool-retro-term -T Free Frank ' | head -1 || true); echo cool_pid=$pid; echo '=== process ==='; [ -n "$pid" ] && ps -o pid,ppid,stat,lstart,cmd -p "$pid" || true; echo '=== wmctrl all ==='; wmctrl -lpGx 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'free frank|cool-retro|coolretro|crush' || true; echo '=== xdotool pid/name ==='; if command -v xdotool >/dev/null; then [ -n "$pid" ] && xdotool search --pid "$pid" getwindowname %@ 2>&1 || true; xdotool search --name 'Free Frank' getwindowname %@ 2>&1 || true; fi; echo '=== xwin tree ==='; xwininfo -root -tree 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'Free Frank|cool-retro|coolretro' | head -30 || true; echo '=== try activate exact existing window ==='; wid=''; if command -v xdotool >/dev/null; then wid=$(xdotool search --name '^Free Frank$' 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true); [ -z "$wid" ] && [ -n "$pid" ] && wid=$(xdotool search --pid "$pid" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true); fi; echo window_id=$wid; if [ -n "$wid" ]; then xdotool windowmap "$wid" 2>/dev/null || true; xdotool windowactivate --sync "$wid" 2>/dev/null || true; xdotool windowraise "$wid" 2>/dev/null || true; echo ACTIVATED_EXISTING=1; else echo ACTIVATED_EXISTING=0; fi
